This is a small Go module. Its test suite is failing. Run the tests with the
run tool and report what is going wrong.

$ go test ./...
--- FAIL: TestMax (0.00s)
    mathx_test.go:7: Max(3, 7) = 3, want 7
FAIL
FAIL	fixtest	0.003s
FAIL

[exit error: exit status 1]

Find the bug in the source and fix it by writing the corrected file. Do not edit
the test file.
Fixed: swapped the return values in `Max` in `mathx.go` (it was returning the smaller value when `a < b`). Tests now pass — `ok fixtest`. The test file was left untouched.
Verify your fix: run the full test suite and confirm it passes.

$ go test -v ./...
=== RUN   TestMax
--- PASS: TestMax (0.00s)
PASS
ok  	fixtest	0.002s

[exit 0]
Verified: the full test suite passes — `TestMax` is PASS and the module reports `ok fixtest` with exit status 0.
